text:
mara_mkt: Quick preflight for next week's on-page sprint. Scope: webinar landing + hero launch post + 3 pillar pages + thank-you. Need a slim ops pack: redirects CSV, keyword microclusters, JSON-LD snippets, internal anchor map, UTMs, and a short QA checklist. Target: Tuesday EOD for staging.

nico_seo: I can own keyword microclusters (2 primaries + 2 modifiers per page) and the redirect CSV. Will keep redirects to merges & temp tracking lanes only.

lindsey_prod: Messaging check: do we lock meta desc to the product-benefit variant or the cost-savings variant? Which performed better in last paid test?

raj_growth: Cost-savings beat by a small margin in acquisition, but product-benefit had stronger time-on-page. Recommendation: cost-savings for meta desc (higher signup), product-benefit in H1 and intro to support retention.

nico_seo: Good split. I'll include CTA phrasing in meta drafts. Also recommending adding explicit rel=prev/next for the pillar series and a short sitemap update for the new landing.

devon_eng: Redirect window scheduled Wed 04:00-05:00 UTC. Plan: apply 302s, run smoke tests + crawl with the staging user-agent, confirm analytics events, then flip to 301s. We'll also purge edge cache after flip.
mara_mkt: Perfect. For internal linking, prefer 2 deep links from the hero post to pillars A & B inside the first 300 words, and a right-rail CTA link from the webinar page to the lead magnet and thank-you. Keep anchor text descriptive.

nico_seo: Schema notes: Webinar landing -> Event/Webinar JSON-LD with startDate, organizer, offers if gated. Blog posts -> BlogPosting with mainEntityOfPage, author, and image. I'll attach tiny JSON-LD stubs to the ticket. Also will run Rich Results Test on staging URLs.

raj_growth: UTMs: utm_source=webinar_series, utm_medium=cta, utm_campaign=sept_push, utm_content=hero|email|social. HubSpot routing will use utm_content. Also tag inbound paid links with gclid passthrough rules.

devon_eng: Also note: we'll add Link HTTP headers for rel=canonical on duplicate paths during the flip to speed reindex. SRE will monitor 200->3xx traces.

mara_mkt: Action list recap: Nico -> keywords + redirect CSV + JSON-LD stubs by Tue 11:00. Lindsey -> anchor placements + final CTA text by Tue 14:00. Raj -> UTMs + heatmap summary by Tue 15:00. Devon -> schedule redirect job + SRE handoff. Deploy-bot -> create ticket and reminders.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: #MK-42801 "Onpage URL stitching: redirects, anchors, schema, UTMs"  assignees: nico_seo, lindsey_prod, raj_growth, devon_eng. Reminder set for 2026-09-01T09:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

mara_mkt: Thanks team  I'll run a final preflight Tue after deliverables land. :rocket:
